name: update
about: A 20-27 s update film ("vX is out"): the name and the version centred, then 2-4 changes, each a picture and a line in its own shape (the card working, then its line risen from the bar the card folds into or read on the colour field; or the line first, round the card in its gap or alone), each card brought in by a creative device from fx/creative where one shows the change (cursor-follow on a tap, bubble-swarm on the pings a change ends, split-compare on a before -> after, photo-arc on photos, logo-orbit on the products it works with), the changed UI filling the frame on its beat, a recap of every change, the version mark built from it. The camera moves only with a device (a push onto the pointer, a pull back) and nothing bobs or tilts. The film fills src/update.ts only; every slot deals one of its devices per film (src/deal.ts), the creative devices from the deck (src/dealt.ts) or the name. new-film.sh --format update lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every update film is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): the track carries the film, its biggest entry on the recap and its final hit on the version mark; earshot effects mark the UI (taps, highlights, state changes); never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 112-128 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track)
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --format update --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py fit --end auto  (once update.ts is written: the edit is fitted to the film's bars, the track's entry on the recap's bar, its own ending, else one ringing hit, on the version mark)

next: update film: write src/update.ts, the one file the film fills: the version and the one before it, 2-4 changes, each one plain sentence (2-6 words, a result the user sees) with its key words (`key`: set apart by colour, weight or scale), its screen's title and the moment that proves it:

tap (an action, the state it changes to, `you`: the viewer the tap adds), fill (a list, grid or week that fills), swap (before -> after) or count (a figure that rises), in the product's own words; people and places are real photos (node scripts/assets.mjs get), never initials;

what the creative devices show when the change has it: before (2-4 steps of the old way, or 4-7 pings it ends), photos (5+), logos (3+ products it works with), swap (2-3 words the key word rolls through),

the type pairing: npx tsx scripts/type-deal.ts --seed "<name>" (fx/TypePairs), unless the brand brings its own face; the deal follows the name: the command in template.json deal.print (PIN a slot, or SEED to re-deal; deck.py --creative deals the devices into src/dealt.ts),

look at the end first: npx remotion still src/index.ts Film out/stills/end.png --frame=<TOTAL - 1> --scale=0.5, then a sampled sheet (npx remotion render src/index.ts FilmEvery out/sheet --sequence --image-format=jpeg --props='{"step":24}' --scale=0.5) before any full render,
then the track: track.py fit --end auto cuts it to these bars (template.json music)

deal.seed: the product's name (IDENTITY.name), or SEED in src/deal.ts; PIN chooses a slot by hand
deal.print: npx tsx -e "import { DEAL, DEAL_SOURCE, LINES, CARD_TONE, PICTURE, LINE_DEVICE } from './src/deal'; console.log(DEAL_SOURCE, JSON.stringify(DEAL), 'cards', CARD_TONE, 'voice', LINES.voice, 'exit', LINES.exitVoice, 'pictures', JSON.stringify(PICTURE), 'lines', JSON.stringify(LINE_DEVICE))"

ground.nearWhite: a paper sweep lit from the top left
ground.lightStudio: a light grey studio sweep: a top key over a falling floor
ground.softSky: a pale sky, deeper at the top
ground.gradientField: a pale tinted mesh: two lobes of the field hue from opposite corners
ground.whiteBand: white with one lit band of the brand colour across the top
ground.blackField: studio black under one soft key from above left
ground.studio: a mid slate cyclorama: a broad top key over a slate floor
ground.deepPool: a deep field at the accent hue with a glow rising from the bottom edge
ground.duskMesh: a deep tinted night: two lobes of the field hue
ground.floorGlow: near-black with one glow of the field hue rising from the floor
ground.lightDark: a light page that turns to a dark stage once, as the colour field fills the frame

hook.roll: "[Name] [old version]" centred; the changed numerals roll on a drum to the new version once the name is read
hook.rise: the name, then the version rising out of a mask in its place beside it (the pair centred from the first frame)
hook.badge: the name alone, centred; a dot lands after it and grows into the pill that carries the version (the end card keeps the pill)

arrive.rise: a card no creative device brings rises into place, whole within the move's first fifth
arrive.open: a hairline at the centre grows across and opens down into the card

order.show: the picture first (the card comes in and works), then the card folds shut into a bar of light and its line rises from it, alone in the middle
order.after: the picture first, then the element that changed grows into the frame's lit colour field and the line reads on it (once a film: the colour event, the ground taking its own event under it); the field closes into the next card or into the dot its device starts from
order.split: the line first, parted round the card, which sits small in the gap between its words; the words leave and the card grows out of the gap as the new screen and works
order.lead: the line first, alone (the card before it folds into the bar it rises from), then this change's card comes in and works
order.rule: a line never follows a line: once a change opens on its picture, the later ones do too; one picture hands over to the next by the element that changed growing into the next card

creative.entrance: pixel-assemble, shape-morph, object-turn (any card), bubble-swarm (before: 4-7 pings; the rows land as they are drawn in), split-compare (before: 2-4 steps, or a swap; the product works beside the old way), photo-arc (photos: 5+), logo-orbit (logos: 3+): they bring a card in after a line
creative.scene: cursor-follow (a tap): the camera pushes onto the pointer, rides it to the button, clicks on the hit and pulls back to the card reacting
creative.line: scale-contrast on the field line (its key word huge), letter-swing or word-swap (swap: 2-3 words) on a line of its own
creative.deal: the deck's devices (src/dealt.ts creative, then its reserve) or the name's: each on the change it shows, two or more a film; a device this template does not play (zoom-wall, data-sculpture, colour-flood, dot-button, type-object, type-window, split-around) passes to the next

recap.deal: the carried card lands in the recap row and the other changes slide out from behind it
recap.rise: the cards rise into the recap row (always, when the last change ends on its line)

end.stack: the recap's cards slide onto each other at the centre and the pile shrinks into the mark; the name comes out of it first letter first, the version lands on the last bar line
end.fold: the other cards tuck behind the last one at the centre, which shrinks into the mark; then the name and the version

lines.moves: every line on one move (mask, fall or crisp) and one whole-line exit (lift or recede), dealt per film: no line travels sideways or leaves word by word; every line's key word is set apart (the accent, or its line device)

cards.light: kit/card Card, light, on any ground (standing a little off a light ground)
cards.dark: on a dark ground only, dealt: kit/card Card dark, 8-12 L* over the ground (src/deal.ts CARD_TONE)
